rationale: The candidate preserves the immutable acceptance boundary while creating substantial provider-neutral headroom, and appropriately treats the V3/V4 failures as evidence consistent with—not proof of—a ceiling-anchoring cause. Its prompt-first approach also avoids decoder caps that could produce truncated or invalid output; the main residual caveat is that the proposed retry should remain a separately evaluated escalation, since it exceeds the stated prompt-text-only scope.
